name: Disable Automatic Optional Updates
description: Disables automatic installation of optional Windows feature updates to keep gaming and production systems stable. Security patches continue normally, but non-security features will not install until you choose them manually.

description_i18n.en: Disables automatic installation of optional Windows feature updates to keep gaming and production systems stable. Security patches continue normally, but non-security features will not install until you choose them manually.
description_i18n.de: Verhindert die automatische Installation optionaler Windows-Funktionsupdates für mehr Stabilität bei Gaming- und Produktivsystemen. Sicherheitspatches werden weiterhin normal installiert; nicht-sicherheitsrelevante Features müssen manuell nachinstalliert werden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'installation automatique des mises à jour de fonctionnalités Windows optionnelles pour stabiliser les systèmes gaming et de production. Les correctifs de sécurité continuent normalement, mais les autres fonctions ne s'installeront que si vous le choisissez.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Configures the registry key HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate by setting AllowOptionalContent and SetAllowOptionalContent to 0 This policy prevents automatic optional content installation while leaving security updates unaffected
